run_benchmarks_cli: run the HuggingFace transformers benchmark CLI with repository, branch, commit_id, and commit_msg arguments
create_metrics_recorder: create a MetricsRecorder instance to collect and export benchmark data to database or CSV
initialise_benchmark: initialise a new benchmark and return its UUID for tracking measurements
collect_device_measurements: collect device-level metrics like CPU usage, memory, GPU usage, and GPU memory for a benchmark
collect_model_measurements: collect model-level timing metrics such as forward pass time and token generation time for a benchmark
